description: Source file implementing the VsockCameraDevice class for Android camera HAL, including methods for camera resource management, characteristics retrieval, and device control.

classes.name: VsockCameraDevice
classes.description: Implementation of a camera device interface for Android HAL using vsock connection.

methods.name: getResourceCost
methods.description: Retrieves the resource cost for the camera device.

methods.name: setTorchMode
methods.description: Sets the torch mode; currently not supported.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the camera device and initializes the session.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Dumps the current state of the camera device to a file descriptor.
